name: road_stone
prompt: The first references are approved STYLE only. The last image is current SUBJECT/geometry only, not a style standard. Match the approved original villager reference: the same fine thin dark-brown ink linework and flat watercolour wash, broad quiet color areas, gentle two-tone cel shadows, sparse interior marks, warm upper-left light and subtle cool shadow color. Preserve refined small-scale readability. No heavy black outlines, glossy rendering, thick sticker edges, dense hatching or indiscriminate saturation. Restore controlled subject-specific color accents like the villager royal-blue scarf; do not wash every material in sandy beige. Paint irregular worn limestone paving closely preserving the last image stone scale, loose polygon layout and restrained thin joints. Cooler pearl-grey limestone with pale blue-grey shade and warm sunlit edges, no yellow overall tint, no dark thick gaps. Flat top-down swatch filling the entire square. No horizon, vignette, objects, border or text. Low contrast suitable for repeated ground sampling.
